# The modules that are Ljós's own (`import Ljos`, `import QtTest`), as their
# native types declare them, in the format of `qt_types`. Do not edit:
# `crates/ljos_cli/tests/own_types.rs` writes this file, and fails when it
# is not what the types declare now.
#
#     LJOS_OWN_TYPES=write cargo test -p ljos_cli --test own_types

module Ljos
	uses QtQuick
	ErrorBoundary Ljos.ErrorBoundary
	type Ljos.ErrorBoundary ErrorBoundary
		prototype Item named
		default content
		prop content Component named pointer
		prop fallback Component named pointer
		prop item QtObject named pointer readonly
		prop failed bool named readonly
		prop fault Ljos.ErrorBoundaryFault pointer readonly
		prop catchExceptions bool named
		prop maxRestarts int named
		prop within int named
		prop restarts int named readonly
		signal contentChanged
		signal fallbackChanged
		signal itemChanged
		signal failedChanged
		signal catchExceptionsChanged
		signal maxRestartsChanged
		signal withinChanged
		signal restartsChanged
		method retry
	type Ljos.ErrorBoundaryFault ErrorBoundaryFault
		is uncreatable
		prop kind string named readonly
		prop message string named readonly
		prop file url named readonly
		prop line int named readonly
		signal kindChanged
		signal messageChanged
		signal fileChanged
		signal lineChanged

module QtTest
	uses QtQml
	uses QtQuick
	GrabbedImage QtTest.GrabbedImage
	SignalSpy QtTest.SignalSpy
	TestCase QtTest.TestCase
	TouchEventSequence QtTest.TouchEventSequence
	type QtTest.GrabbedImage GrabbedImage
		prototype QtObject named
		is uncreatable
		prop width int named readonly
		prop height int named readonly
		prop size var named readonly
		method pixel
		method red
		method green
		method blue
		method alpha
		method equals
		method save
	type QtTest.SignalSpy SignalSpy
		prototype Item named
		prop target QtObject named pointer
		prop signalName string named
		prop count int named readonly
		prop signalArguments var named readonly
		prop valid bool named readonly
		signal targetChanged
		signal signalNameChanged
		signal countChanged
		signal signalArgumentsChanged
		signal validChanged
		method clear
		method wait
	type QtTest.TestCase TestCase
		prototype Item named
		prop name string named
		prop when bool named
		prop windowShown bool named readonly
		prop completed bool named readonly
		prop running bool named readonly
		prop optional bool named
		signal nameChanged
		signal whenChanged
		signal windowShownChanged
		signal completedChanged
		signal runningChanged
		signal optionalChanged
		method compare
		method verify
		method fuzzyCompare
		method fail
		method skip
		method warn
		method expectFail
		method expectFailContinue
		method tryCompare
		method tryVerify
		method wait
		method sleep
		method waitForRendering
		method isPolishScheduled
		method waitForPolish
		method createTemporaryObject
		method createTemporaryQmlObject
		method findChild
		method grabImage
		method mouseClick
		method mouseDoubleClickSequence
		method mousePress
		method mouseRelease
		method mouseMove
		method mouseDrag
		method mouseWheel
		method keyClick
		method keyPress
		method keyRelease
		method keySequence
		method touchEvent
	type QtTest.TouchEventSequence TouchEventSequence
		prototype QtObject named
		is uncreatable
		method press
		method move
		method release
		method stationary
		method commit
